correctness.rationale: Finite birational normalizations give canonical measure weights (a-1)q and (b-1)q; the product Jacobian has block-diagonal minimal minors so fixed-radius volumes factor; conditional CRT averaging gives the rational formula. The gcd=1 case and genuine gcd>1 defect are verified by formal rational algebra and the Hodge-Deligne indeterminate specialization. The assertion is limited to the embedded density because the product singular locus is nonisolated.

value.rationale: The theorem determines an infinite two-parameter family of natural embedded motivic densities and gives an exact iff coprimality condition for density multiplicativity. It exposes a systematic failure of averaging to respect products despite Fubini holding at every fixed radius, and the correction is detectable in the rational Grothendieck ring but collapses in the naive L-to-1 limit.
